描述_EN: when this sculpture arrived at the museum, it contained a lacquer box with offerings of silks, gauze, grain and a bronze mirror. earlier, like all other bodhisattvas, guanyin was depicted in male form. this figure is one of the most popular figures of worship in buddhism – the bodhisattva guanyin, called avalokitesvara in sanskrit. these confirm that the figure was once worshipped in a temple. as the deity of compassion, guanyin was usually shown from the 10th century onwards as a female figure.
描述_ZN: 当这个雕塑到达博物馆时，它包含了一个漆盒，里面有丝绸、纱布、谷物和一面铜镜等供品。 早些时候，像其他所有的菩萨一样，观音是以男性的形式被描绘的。 这个人物是佛教中最受欢迎的崇拜人物之一--观世音菩萨，在梵文中称为阿瓦罗基斯瓦罗。 这些都证实了这尊雕塑曾经在寺庙中被供奉过。 作为慈悲之神，观世音菩萨从10世纪起通常以女性形象出现。
